name: Image Input
description: Accepts image content in requests.

name: File Input
description: Accepts file content in requests.

name: Video Input
description: Accepts video content in requests.

name: Audio Input
description: Accepts audio content in requests.

name: Image Output
description: Can return image content alongside text.

name: Audio Output
description: Can return audio content alongside text.

name: Reasoning
description: Produces reasoning tokens before its answer.

name: Mandatory Reasoning
source: is_mandatory_reasoning on model reasoning_config or endpoint features
description: Reasoning cannot be turned off.

name: Reasoning Off by Default
description: Reasons only when a request enables it.

name: Reasoning Effort
values: low high max 152; low medium high xhigh max 122; high max low 107; high low medium xhigh max 87; low medium high 64; high xhigh 51; medium minimal low high 37; high low medium xhigh 31
description: Accepts these reasoning effort levels.

name: Default Effort
values: high 307; medium 264; max 143; xhigh 32; minimal 28; low 5
description: Effort level used when a request does not set one.

name: Reasoning Budget
description: Accepts a reasoning token budget (reasoning.max_tokens).

name: Hidden Reasoning
description: Reasons, but does not return its reasoning.

name: Tools
description: Function calling through the tools parameter.

name: Tool Choice
description: Accepts the tool_choice parameter.

name: Required Tool Choice
description: Can force a tool call with tool_choice 'required'.

name: Named Tool Choice
description: Can force a call to one named function.

name: Parallel Tool Calls
description: Accepts parallel_tool_calls to allow or prevent several tool calls in one turn.
notes: Control parameter, not a sampling parameter. Absence does not establish that calls are never parallel.

name: Native Web Search
description: The provider runs web search itself instead of OpenRouter's plugin.
notes: A web-search price does not imply this.

name: Native Web Fetch
description: The provider fetches URLs itself.

name: Native Apply Patch
description: The provider's native file-patch tool is available.

name: Response Format
description: JSON mode: response_format type json_object.

name: Structured Outputs
description: Enforces a JSON schema: response_format type json_schema.

name: Logprobs
description: Returns token log probabilities.
notes: Listed together with 'top_logprobs' on every endpoint.

name: Predicted Outputs
description: Accepts predicted output text to speed up mostly-known responses, such as code edits.
notes: OpenAI's Predicted Outputs; listed on GPT-4o (openai) and Codestral (mistral).

name: Web Search Options
description: Accepts web_search_options for search-augmented models.
notes: OpenAI, Azure, Perplexity, and Sakana search-style models.

name: Verbosity
description: Accepts a verbosity level for response length.

name: Temperature
description: Accepts temperature.

name: Top P
description: Accepts top_p.

name: Top K
description: Accepts top_k.

name: Min P
description: Accepts min_p.

name: Top A
description: Accepts top_a.
notes: Mostly Mancer.

name: Frequency Penalty
description: Accepts frequency_penalty.

name: Presence Penalty
description: Accepts presence_penalty.

name: Repetition Penalty
description: Accepts repetition_penalty.

name: Seed
description: Accepts seed.

name: Stop Sequences
description: Accepts stop.

name: Logit Bias
description: Accepts logit_bias.

name: Max Tokens
description: Accepts max_tokens.

name: Max Completion Tokens
description: Accepts max_completion_tokens.
notes: Alias of max_tokens; mostly Azure.

name: Reasoning Effort Parameter
description: Accepts reasoning_effort.
notes: Top-level alias of reasoning.effort on 20 endpoints.

name: Completions
description: Legacy /completions endpoint for raw text continuation.

name: No Abort
description: Cancelling a request may not stop generation upstream, and the full response can still be billed.
notes: Description follows OpenRouter's stream-cancellation guide; recheck before publishing.

name: System Prompt Merged
description: System messages are moved to the start and merged into one.

name: Recommended Sampling

description: Has recommended sampling defaults for these parameters.

name: ZDR
description: Zero data retention: prompts are not retained.
notes: Equals not retainsPrompts on every endpoint. The 'zdr' tag segment marks 33 of these.

name: Prompt Retention
description: Retains prompts, for this many days when stated.

name: Training
description: The provider may train on prompts.

name: OpenRouter Training
description: OpenRouter may train on prompts.
notes: Undocumented key; only free variants.

name: Safety Retention
description: Retains prompts for safety review.
notes: Undocumented key; only google-vertex, each with retainsPrompts false.

name: User ID Required
description: Requests must identify the end user.

name: Moderated
description: OpenRouter screens content before forwarding.

name: Requests/Min
description: Rate limited to this many requests per minute.
notes: Model-level values are ignored.

name: Requests/Day
description: Rate limited to this many requests per day.
notes: Model-level values are ignored.

name: Input Limit
description: Prompts are capped below the context length.

name: Image Token Limit
description: Each image is limited to this many tokens.

name: Output Limit Unstated
description: No maximum output length is stated.

name: Reduced Context
source: context_length below the widest endpoint of the model
description: Shorter context than another endpoint of the same model.
notes: Value is endpoint/widest context.

name: Free
description: Free variant. Usually stricter limits and logging terms.
notes: is_free agrees on every endpoint.

name: Batch
description: Asynchronous batch variant.

name: BYOK Only
description: Requires your own provider key; OpenRouter credits cannot pay for it.

name: BYOK
description: The provider accepts your own API key.

name: Deranked
description: Deprioritized in routing; used as a fallback.

name: Disabled
description: Listed but not serving requests.
notes: False on every endpoint in this scan.

name: Deprecating
description: Scheduled for removal on this date.
notes: Model variant dates apply to endpoints.

name: New Endpoint
description: Added recently.
notes: created_at is not always first offering.

name: New Model
